avis.texte: When I use this at night I put ALOT On covering all my pimples which are hard to get rid of . By the next morning my pimples are reduced in size. It does not take the redness away from the pimples just reduces the size. It smells great and works great if you are looking to clear up a pimple overnight.

avis.titre: Love the dispenser & applicator head for finger free application
avis.texte: I'm not sure how effective this is yet. I read good reviews and wanted to try it. I could just have the wrong type of pimples currently and that's why I haven't really noticed any improvement. I'll keep trying when different pimples pop up. I do like the mild scent. I love the dispenser and applicator head so I don't have to touch the product with my fingers when applying it to the problem areas. The product absorbs quickly and is invisible on the skin so you can use it during the daytime. I haven't experienced any skin reaction.

Look like it helps the irritated red spot to calm down a bit temporarily. Maybe more time is needed, will use it for a few more days to see if there is any improvement. It does not dry up the skin. This is moisturing milking cream which helps to stop the irritation in just a few minutes. It makes the skin comfortable and soothing.

I'm definitely going to get more of this, before the one I have is gone so I have a backup / don't have a time gap where I don't have any around. It works really, really well. It doesn't do anything about redness (which is what I was expecting given the item name), but it's very effective for reducing the size of acne. In most cases I put it on a spot 1-3 times during the day, and when I wake up the next day the spot is flat or nearly flat. Occasionally it's taken 2-3 days. It doesn't seem to matter whether the spot is red or not, has a whitehead in the center or not, has been picked at or not, etc. I've been using my finger to put it on rather than the applicator thing where the actual ointment comes out, because it kept ending up with some on the back side of the applicator when I tried putting it on with that. The one I got in September 2021 expires on February 23, 2023.
